subtopics.title: Ohm's Law and the Conductors That Break It

questions.question: Ohm's law states that the current through a conductor is directly proportional to the potential difference across it, provided that:
A potential difference of 12 V drives 3 A through a resistor. Its resistance is:
On a current-versus-voltage graph, an ohmic conductor at constant temperature appears as:
options: A curve that flattens at high voltage
A straight line through the origin

questions.question: A light bulb filament is non-ohmic because:
options: Its length changes as it glows
It has no resistance when cold
Its resistance rises as its temperature climbs, so current stops growing in proportion to voltage

subtopics.title: Resistors in Series and in Parallel

questions.question: A 4 Ω and a 12 Ω resistor connected in SERIES have a total resistance of:
The same 4 Ω and 12 Ω connected in PARALLEL give:
Resistors of 6 Ω, 3 Ω and 2 Ω in parallel have a combined resistance of:
Which quantity is the same for all resistors connected in parallel?

subtopics.title: Solving a Mixed Network Step by Step

questions.question: A 12 V battery feeds a 2 Ω resistor in series with a parallel pair of 6 Ω and 3 Ω. The total resistance is:
In that circuit, the total current from the battery is:
The potential difference across the parallel pair is:
options: 6 V, the battery's 12 V minus the 6 V across the series resistor

questions.question: The 6 V across the pair splits the 3 A so that:
options: The 6 Ω carries 2 A and the 3 Ω carries 1 A
The 6 Ω carries 3 A and the 3 Ω carries nothing
The 6 Ω carries 1 A and the 3 Ω carries 2 A — the smaller resistance takes the larger share

subtopics.title: Power, Energy and the Price of Electricity

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a correct formula for electrical power?
A battery delivers 12 V at 3 A. Its total power output is:
The kilowatt-hour is a unit of:
A 2 kW kettle runs for 30 minutes at a tariff of R2,50 per kWh. The cost is:
In the traffic picture, adding a resistor in series is like:
options: Adding another roadblock to the only road, slowing everything

questions.question: Adding a resistor in parallel LOWERS the total resistance because:
options: The new resistor absorbs the current
The voltage drops across the new branch
Every new branch is another open road, so more total current can flow
Parallel resistors switch each other off

questions.question: Homes are wired in parallel so that:
options: Each appliance gets the full supply voltage and can switch off without cutting the others
The total resistance stays as high as possible

subtopics.title: Walking Through the Circuit Like a Marker

questions.question: The four moves for a mixed circuit, in order, are:
options: Split the amps, spend the volts, total current, shrink
Spend the volts, shrink, split, total
Shrink the network, find total current, spend the volts, split the amps

questions.question: After the series resistor takes its share, the volts left over land across:
The audit at the end of the walk checks that:
options: The branch currents add up to the current that arrived at the junction
Each resistor carries the same current
The battery voltage equals the total current

questions.question: Between two parallel branches, the branch with the smaller resistance carries:
options: The same current as the other branch

subtopics.title: Reading the Bill Like a Physicist

questions.question: One kilowatt-hour is the energy used by:
options: A 1 kW appliance running for one hour
Any appliance running for one hour
A 1 W appliance running for one hour
A 1 kW appliance running for one second

questions.question: A 3 kW geyser heating for 4 hours a day uses, per day:
Watts and kilowatt-hours differ in that:
options: Watts measure energy and kilowatt-hours measure power
They are the same quantity in different sizes
Watts measure how fast energy is used; kilowatt-hours measure how much was used

questions.question: The most effective way to cut a household electricity bill is to:
options: Unplug phone chargers when not in use
Switch lights on and off frequently
Reduce the hours and losses of high-power appliances like the geyser
